ModMetaData.name: Construction Pipeline Optimizer
ModMetaData.author: Coolnether123
ModMetaData.description:
Reduces redundant validation in active construction jobs and avoids one global work search in the zero-cost terrain pipeline.
The optimization asks the active construction work giver for the next job after a completed no-cost frame, preserving mod-supplied replacement and prerequisite jobs. When the exact vanilla validation hook is free of direct Harmony conflicts, it distributes repeated FinishFrame validation over a deterministic cadence and pairs that with a final authorization check immediately before completion. If compatibility or IL checks fail, the broad feature disables itself instead of guessing.
No settings or save data. Normally safe to add or remove between sessions, but keep a normal save backup when changing a mod list.
RimWorld Multiplayer is supported on RimWorld 1.6. CPO uses the official Multiplayer API only for detection and keeps construction decisions inside Multiplayer's deterministic map-tick simulation. Every player must use the same CPO version and mod list.
Do not enable this with Construction Queue Optimizer; that legacy package contains the same construction patches.
